violations.why: closer2_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var1 in JudgeCondi and change its value.
writer2_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var2, so the two reads can return different values.
closer2_isr has higher priority and runs i8xx_tco_release, which resets tco_expect_close to 0. If it runs between closer1's write of 42 and its check, the check fails.
closer2_isr can preempt closer1_isr inside i8xx_tco_write, between its two writes to tco_expect_close, and read the intermediate value.
